name: wildcat-brand-imagegen
description: Contributor-gated Wildcat brand and mascot references for image generation, fetched only for the active request.

interface.shortDescription: Private Wildcat brand references, scoped to one image-generation request.
interface.longDescription: Uses Fiat's contributor authorization before fetching the private Wildcat brand and mascot references into a temporary directory. Matching image-generation requests receive the references; unrelated requests never fetch them, and cleanup follows every attempt.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a Wildcat-branded visual using the private brand references.
